Package neqsim.process.engineering.model

Class EngineeringDiagramMassBalanceReconciliation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.model.EngineeringDiagramMassBalanceReconciliation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringDiagramMassBalanceReconciliation extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, deterministic mass-balance data-reconciliation evidence.

This projection joins a governed stream table, its explicit-boundary balance table, and an EngineeringDiagramBalanceAssessment. Only balances whose complete mass residual is explicitly classified EngineeringDiagramBalanceAssessment.Status.OUTSIDE_TOLERANCE are reconciled. Each participating boundary stream requires a sourced positive standard uncertainty in kg/s. NeqSim's existing weighted-least-squares reconciliation engine then enforces the declared inlet-minus-outlet mass constraint.

The source snapshots are never modified. Reconciled values are evidence proposals only; they are not written back to a ProcessSystem, stream table, balance table, PFD, DEXPI export, or P&ID. This class does not reconcile component flows or energy terms, model covariance between variables, eliminate gross errors, or promote review evidence to engineering approval.
